answer.label: quantized
answer.justification: The activation profile matches quantized: relative L2 is 0.096 at layer 1, 0.184 at layer 8 and 0.194 at layer 16, then nearly flat at 0.205 at layer 24 and 0.255 at layer 32. Other internal measures also fit: effective rank 4.09, direction consistency 0.514, cosine 0.966, mid-layer size ratio 0.968 (shrinking), and onset layer 11. Logit changes are the smallest of the categories (KL 0.039, top-1 agreement 0.957, TV 0.040). Text rates stay close to the reference and the median first divergence is 8.5. Fine-tuned is ruled out because the size ratio is below 1 and the effective rank is about 4, whereas fine-tuned models grow in size and have lower rank and higher direction consistency. System-prompted is ruled out by the median first divergence of 8.5 (not 0), the tiny layer-2 spike (0.1) and the low KL. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
